subtopics.title: Resultants, Tail-to-Head and the Closed Diagram

questions.question: Which statement correctly separates vectors from scalars?
options: A vector has magnitude and direction; a scalar has magnitude only
A vector has magnitude only; a scalar has direction only
Vectors are always forces; scalars are always distances
A scalar is any quantity smaller than one

questions.question: In the tail-to-head construction, the resultant is drawn from:
options: The head of the last vector to the tail of the first
The tail of the first vector to the head of the last
The midpoint of the first vector to the midpoint of the last
The origin to the tail of the second vector

questions.question: Vectors drawn tail-to-head form a closed diagram, the last head landing on the first tail. This means:
options: The vectors were drawn in the wrong order
The largest vector dominates the motion
The resultant is zero and the object is in equilibrium
The resultant equals the perimeter of the diagram

questions.question: The equilibrant of a set of forces is:
options: The average of all the forces
The smallest force present
Twice the resultant, in the same direction
Equal in magnitude to the resultant but opposite in direction

subtopics.title: Resolving a Vector into Perpendicular Components

questions.question: For a vector R at angle θ measured from the x-axis:
options: Rx = R sinθ and Ry = R cosθ
Rx = R cosθ and Ry = R sinθ
Rx = R tanθ and Ry = R sinθ
Rx = R and Ry = R

questions.question: The reliable way to decide between sine and cosine when resolving is:
options: Sketch the right-angled triangle: the side adjacent to the marked angle uses cosine, the side opposite it uses sine
Always give cosine to the horizontal component, no matter where the angle sits
Use sine for forces and cosine for displacements
Choose whichever function gives a positive answer

questions.question: A winch cable pulls with 300 N at 40° above the horizontal. Its horizontal component is:
Taking east and north as positive, a 150 N force due west is recorded as:

subtopics.title: Adding the Components of Four Forces

questions.question: When adding vectors by components, the correct procedure is to:
options: Add every component into one grand total
Add all x-components together and all y-components together, in separate columns
Add only the two largest vectors
Multiply the x-components by the y-components

questions.question: For the four plate forces (300 N at 40°, 140 N north, 150 N west, 60 N south), Rx equals:
options: 379,8 N east
79,8 N east
229,8 N east
70,2 N west

questions.question: For the same four forces, Ry equals:
options: 332,8 N north
132,8 N north
272,8 N north
27,2 N south

questions.question: Why write "x = 0" for a force that points due north instead of leaving the entry blank?
options: Because northward forces have a hidden eastward part
Because zeros make the final answer larger
Because the x-column may not contain empty spaces by convention
Because it is written proof that the vector was resolved and not forgotten

subtopics.title: Magnitude by Pythagoras, Direction by Trigonometry

questions.question: With Rx = 79,8 N and Ry = 272,8 N, the magnitude of the resultant is:
The direction of that resultant is found from:
options: θ = tan⁻¹(Ry ÷ Rx) = tan⁻¹(3,419) = 73,7° north of east
θ = sin⁻¹(Rx ÷ Ry) = 17° east of north
θ = cos⁻¹(Rx × Ry) = 45°
θ = Ry − Rx = 193°

questions.question: A learner's inverse tangent returns 1,29 instead of 73,7. The most likely cause is:
options: The components were added in the wrong order
The square root was skipped
The calculator is set to radian mode instead of degree mode
The angle is genuinely 1,29 degrees

questions.question: Two ropes pull a trolley with 45 N east and 60 N north. The resultant is:
options: 105 N at 45° north of east
15 N due north
5 625 N at 53,1° north of east
75 N at 53,1° north of east

subtopics.title: Walking to the Shop the Long Way

questions.question: You walk 90 m east then 120 m north. The distance walked and the resultant displacement are:
options: 210 m walked, 150 m displacement
150 m walked, 210 m displacement
210 m walked, 210 m displacement
30 m walked, 150 m displacement

questions.question: Walking the north leg first and the east leg second changes:
options: The direction of the resultant only
Nothing about the resultant — you finish on the same corner
The magnitude of the resultant only
Both the magnitude and the direction

questions.question: A series of walks brings you back through your own gate. In the language of forces this means:
options: Each individual force must have been zero
The object is accelerating in the direction of the last walk
The resultant is zero, everything cancels, and the object is in equilibrium
The forces must all have been equal in size

subtopics.title: Splitting One Push into Two Honest Pushes

questions.question: A hockey-bag strap is pulled at an upward slope. Splitting the pull into a forward part and an upward part means:
options: The pull has been sorted into two perpendicular parts with the same combined effect
The pull is now twice as strong
Part of the pull has been thrown away
Two new forces have been added to the bag

questions.question: A pull sloping only slightly above the ground has:
options: A small forward part and a large upward part
Equal forward and upward parts
A large forward part and a small upward part
No forward part at all

questions.question: The upward part of a 300 N pull sloping 40° above the ground is:
In the sorting picture, the side of the triangle lying snug against the marked angle uses:
options: Sine
Tangent
The inverse tangent
Cosine

questions.question: Adding the sideways parts 229,8 N east and 150 N west gives:
options: 379,8 N east
79,8 N west
379,8 N west
79,8 N east

questions.question: Adding the vertical parts 192,8 N north, 140 N north and 60 N south gives:
options: 272,8 N north
392,8 N north
12,8 N south
272,8 N south

questions.question: Submitting "284,2 N" with no direction is a problem because:
options: The magnitude cannot be correct without a direction
Newtons are the wrong unit for a resultant force
A vector answer is incomplete without its direction, and only part of the marks can be awarded
Directions are only required for displacement vectors

questions.question: The three moves of the component method, in order, are:
options: Measure with a ruler, convert to scale, state the answer
Split every vector into two perpendicular parts, add each pile separately, rebuild one arrow with Pythagoras and the inverse tangent
Add all the magnitudes, then divide by the number of vectors
Find the largest vector and subtract all the others from it
